text: OlimpBet is the brand of BK Olimp LLC, which is 97.5% owned by Zevs LLC and 2.5% by its general director Sergey Kozyavkin.
short: BK Olimp (OlimpBet) is 97.5% owned by Zevs LLC, 2.5% by its director.

source.name: Rusprofile (EGRUL register data): ООО «БК „Олимп“»
source.quote: Основным владельцем выступает юридическое лицо ООО "ЗЕВС" с долей 97,5%, тогда как сам директор владеет 2,5% уставного капитала
source.note: Russian company register (EGRUL) data for BK Olimp LLC, via a Wayback Machine snapshot of 22 Dec 2025; rusprofile.ru serves 403 to scripts. Translation: the main owner is the legal entity ZEVS LLC with a 97.5% stake, while the director himself owns 2.5% of the charter capital.

additionalSources.name: Stavka.tv: Компания Олимпбет: кто создал и кто владелец
additionalSources.note: Names Zevs LLC as holder of 97.5% of BK Olimp and Sergey Kozyavkin as holder of 2.5%; says the figures come from public registers.
